newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bufete wins BASF Mexicana deal.
newsitem.headline: Bufete wins BASF Mexicana deal.

text.p: Mexican engineering firm Bufete Industrial said Tuesday it had been awarded the third phase of a polystyrene project by BASF AG's BASF Mexicana.

The fixed-price project involves the installation of a polystyrene plant in BASF Mexicana's Altamira complex in Tamaulipas, Mexico, that would produce 143,000 tons per year of crystal polystyrene, mostly for export.

"Bufete has already successfully executed the detailed engineering, procurement and civil construction work for the polystyrene project," Joaquin Rodriguez, Bufete's engineering vice president, said in a statement.
